description: Paginated listing of every registered FRC team with reduced fields (key, team_number, nickname, name, city, state_prov, country). Lighter than get_teams; use when website, motto, address, and geocoded location are not needed.

page_num.description: Zero-indexed page number for paginated team listings. TBA returns up to 500 teams per page; increment until the response is empty to enumerate all teams.

name: get_teams_simple
